notes: v578 — THE LOADING FIX. Your admin panel shows the server store holds 753 of 760 days for the ASX, back to August 2023 — the data was always there. But the app only ever asked it for the LAST 14 DAYS, and it refused to create history for a share that had none (a rule written when the store held closing prices only — it now keeps full bars). So every share without saved history fell back to a free public relay: 4,298 separate requests, which is where the crawling loads and the hangs came from. NEW BUTTON in Setup & data: ⚡ FILL FROM MY SERVER STORE. It builds your saved history straight from your own server, ONE REQUEST PER TRADING DAY (about 4,300 bars each) instead of one per share — roughly 300 days for every share, with a running commentary. Use it now, then reload: loading should be dramatically faster and the free relay stops mattering. Your normal load path is unchanged — this is an extra, deliberate action. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5), open Setup & data, press it once.
